rationale: ROUND 2 on the same correlation, and the round-1 gating objections were RIGHT about the submission and WRONG about the work — which is the submission's fault, stated plainly: round 1 compressed eleven files into eight edit entries to fit the cap, naming three in prose ('the identical one-line change'), and the editquality seat correctly read prose-named files as unshipped work. All nine A1 files were in fact committed before round 1 (8552e621d + 0702fb9cb, and the cmd/ CLI file within them); nothing ships unstamped. This round stops compressing: the bundle splits into two submissions — THIS one is A1 complete, with every in-scope file its own edit entry (exactly 8), and migration 552 resubmits separately — and cmd/webdesignport/import.go is absent from the edits array because scripts/council-scope.sh admits only ^(platform|internal|pkg)/ and migrations, so a cmd/ path structurally cannot be an edit entry; its inline stamp (after upsertPage's db.Begin(), lib/pq, best-effort) is described here because that is the only place it can be described. Answers to each round-1 objection, in the seats' own order. EDITQUALITY high/high/medium: all three named files are edit entries now (rebuild_blog_listing edit 5, create_tool_component_regenerate edit 7) or scope-excluded as above (import.go). BUG_HISTORIAN medium (Commit() error elided): the sketch elided it; the SHIPPED code does not — 'if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil { return nil, err }' is verbatim at content_write_stamp.go, so a failed Commit IS the operation's error and the silent-success shape the historian names cannot occur; this round's edit-3 sketch carries the full function body unelided. BUG_HISTORIAN low (per-site convention, no enforcement) and ARCHITECTURE medium (same point): accepted as real and RECORDED rather than silently absorbed — bugs_open/355 §10 now carries the named follow-up: a pattern-check in the check_unrepaired_component_write family (scripts/pattern-check.py) that fires on a changed Go writer of page_components which neither stamps nor is allow-listed; not built in this round because the council explicitly did not block on it and the mitigation stands (an unstamped writer reverts to the socket string, which is distinguishable, not corrupt — the detector's UnattributedNew counter surfaces exactly that population every day). REUSE_AGENT medium (extend withWorkItemTx / UpdateStateWithRetry instead): examined this round, named here as the seat asked. withWorkItemTx (create_tool_cross_link_items.go:346) is work-item-LIFECYCLE machinery — it claims and stamps a site_work_items row inside its tx; reusing it would drag item-claim semantics into every content write. UpdateStateWithRetry does not exist under that name in platform/ (grep, this round). No generic exec-with-stamp wrapper exists to extend; the new helper is 30 lines, single-purpose, and mutation-tested. PRIOR_ART medium (the 2-of-9 tx census unattributed): re-verified FIRST-HAND this round and cited per site in grounded_in — bare autocommit at section_editor_actions.go:1471/:1506, create_report_page_action.go:223, rebuild_blog_listing_action.go:335; transactions only at apply_adoption_plan_action.go:212, create_tool_component_regenerate.go:221, page_admin_handlers.go:299 (+ the CLI's db.Begin()). PRIOR_ART low (does page_admin_handlers.go exist under that exact name): yes — internal/core-manager/admin/page_admin_handlers.go, and its HandleUpdateSiteComponent twin is edit 8's second stamp precisely because the commit-scope pattern check flagged it (016b §9 #26) and the 344 chrome archive captures application_name too. GUARDIAN low (per-pipeline callout): risks below states the three pipelines separately with the measured volume (316 in-place app overwrites in 14 days fleet-wide, ~23/day across ALL of them — section edits, dossier renders, blog rebuilds are each a fraction of that). DEBUG_HISTORIAN low (source grep vs running pod): correct, and the acceptance is designed for it — the post-roll DISTINCT application_name query is the artefact-side instrument, the grep only interprets it, and the daily content-loss-check heartbeat re-reports the unattributed share every run, so erosion of the invariant is WATCHED rather than assumed. ARCHITECTURE low (repurposing a diagnostic field): acknowledged; the erosion risk is the same watched population, and bugs_open/355 records it. No new config keys; optional-key budget untouched.

edits.rationale: The mechanism, full body unelided this round. stampedExecContext: Begin -> set_config('application_name',$1,true) -> write -> Commit, where a Begin or stamp failure falls back to the exact unstamped statement and a write or COMMIT error is returned as the operation's error. stampWriterTx: one stamp inside an existing tx, error logged not returned (the only realistic failure is a dead connection the next statement surfaces as itself). Header documents the two load-bearing form choices, the acceptance predicate, and the writers deliberately NOT stamped (the funnel — op='delete' discriminates it; INSERT-only writers — INSERT is never archived)

The mutation-proven guards, a separate file and a separate edit because the tests are what make the helper's contract falsifiable: ordered sqlmock pins stamp-inside-tx-before-write with the exact is_local=true text (M1/M2); Begin-failure and stamp-failure paths still execute the write (M3); the write's error and a Commit error pass through; RowsAffected passes through

plan.risks: Per pipeline, as the guardian asked. Section editor: human-driven, lowest volume; the wrap turns one autocommit statement into a three-statement tx — atomicity of the single write unchanged, Commit error returned, both failure modes fall back to the exact pre-A1 statement. Dossier renders and blog rebuilds: batch-adjacent but low volume (the three pipelines TOGETHER produce ~23 archived overwrites/day fleet-wide); same fallback posture. Adoption and tool regeneration: no transactional shape change at all — one extra statement inside an existing tx, error logged not propagated. Admin: HandleUpdateComponent unchanged in shape; the twin gains the short tx with explicit unstamped fallback. Under pgbouncer pool_mode=transaction a wrapped write pins one server connection for three statements instead of one — bounded by the volumes above. The residual named by two seats and accepted: the convention is per-site until a pattern-check enforces it, recorded in bugs_open/355 §10 as the named follow-up, and the unattributed share is re-measured daily by content-loss-check's heartbeat so erosion is watched, not assumed.
